title: IDF Kills Nukhba Platoon Commander Tied to Oct. 7 Kisufim Outpost Attack
detail: The IDF says an airstrike in Khan Younis killed Hisham Jamal Abu Qala, a Hamas Nukhba platoon commander who it says helped organize the October 7, 2023 attack on the Kisufim outpost and recently planned attacks on Israeli troops and civilians in violation of the ceasefire. The claim rests on the IDF statement; independent confirmation is limited.
